name: s5000_nemotron35_a3b_tiny_m
comment: MTP6 verify bucket (M=1..28 resolve to key 16) of the S5000 Nemotron MoE table. Only this bucket is listed: it is the only row inside the shipped search grid, so a full-table re-run would replace measured rows with unmeasured ones (use --merge-configs).

16.source: End-to-end measurement on one MTT_S5000 card, same container and image as the comparison arm, using the canonical Nemotron-3.5 MTP6 protocol (4096-in / 1000-out, one warmup plus five measured repeats, byte-identical output digests in every arm): 5.5659 ms/token against 6.6207 ms/token for the previously shipped row (-15.95%). The uniform-routing microbenchmark ranks a different tile for this bucket (BM64/BN128/BK64/GSM1/w8/s1) and does not reproduce that ranking between runs, so the sweep is not authoritative here.
